maneuvers.call: tacked on a lift, new tack neutral

tips: Reached off at 151° to the wind for the first 15–40 s after the mark (your best exited at 157°). Bear away all the way to the run angle first, then set.
Gave away 16 m in the 30 s before the mark. Keep target speed on the layline; don't pinch up to the mark.
Came out pinching at 23° to the wind (your best exited at 50°). Foot at your normal upwind angle until speed is back, then point.
Passed 7 m from the mark. Wide in, tight out: leave it about a boat length (3 m) away on the exit.
Took 27 s to settle on the run (best 11 s). Pole and halyard ready on the layline, so the set happens as you bear away.
Speed dropped 21% through the turn (7.35 → 5.8 kt; best 10%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
Overstood the layline by ~10°. Tack onto it a little sooner and sail the last 100 m at full upwind speed.
